bug_semantics: Upright exposed all-verbs Prometheus and Alertmanager proxy routes to session-authenticated browser users while both proxy controllers called skip_forgery_protection and forwarded the request method, path, and body to their upstream services. An unauthenticated attacker could induce a logged-in victim's browser to issue a cross-site request carrying the ambient session (including a Lax-cookie top-level GET) and reach enabled upstream write or management operations such as creating an Alertmanager silence or requesting Prometheus /-/reload; there was no Fetch-Metadata, Origin, or equivalent provenance gate.
flaw_origin: The public repository does not contain the true implementation origin. dbf67daef2c624c1d5f01ef4233a8bccb3c927aa first adds both skip_forgery_protection proxy controllers to this repository in a 58-file, 2,918-insertion commit explicitly titled 'Move UI and Traceroute probe to engine', but its routes do not expose them. 29b423ea9e0cec753da97105afccf7a694a5b0e6 later adds the all-verbs proxy routes and completes the reachable vulnerable chain in a 98-file, 3,427-insertion/1,905-deletion commit explicitly titled 'Continue extraction of Upright core'. Both are import/extraction aggregates rather than the smallest commit that originally designed the vulnerable proxy, and the pre-extraction source history is absent from this clone.
ai_marker: Unavailable for the true BIC because its commit object is outside the public history. As a non-BIC boundary check only, git cat-file commit on import commits dbf67daef2c624c1d5f01ef4233a8bccb3c927aa and 29b423ea9e0cec753da97105afccf7a694a5b0e6 shows author/committer Lewis Buckley <lewis@37signals.com>, SSH signatures, the subjects 'Move UI and Traceroute probe to engine' and 'Continue extraction of Upright core', and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI attribution trailer. Those marker absences are not used to classify the unavailable true BIC.
evidence: Advisory reproduction: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q9r6-h8cx-q7qp identifies commit efe4f2e5254ac6e57e45d2261804cca74dbbca3f and the two proxy-controller skip_forgery_protection lines, with affected and patched versions both recorded as Unknown. In the validated clone, `git show efe4f2e5254ac6e57e45d2261804cca74dbbca3f:app/controllers/upright/{alertmanager,prometheus}_proxy_controller.rb` shows both skips and forwarding of request method/path/body. `git log -S'skip_forgery_protection' --all --patch` first finds dbf67daef2c624c1d5f01ef4233a8bccb3c927aa; `git log -L '/skip_forgery_protection/,+1':<each-controller> efe4f2e...` independently walks through the 29b423ea reformat to dbf67dae. `git diff --name-status 2a7dfaf0f5411a0195d11c426aeeab8f34a70211 dbf67daef2c624c1d5f01ef4233a8bccb3c927aa -- <the two controllers>` reports both as added, while `git show dbf67dae:config/routes.rb` has no proxy routes. `git log -S'alertmanager_proxy#proxy' -- config/routes.rb` and the analogous Prometheus search show 29b423ea9e0cec753da97105afccf7a694a5b0e6 adding `match ... via: :all`; its parent b5cb6a84bcfff3dd7a58712d49296003aa78852b lacks those routes. `git cat-file commit` plus `git diff --shortstat` gives the quoted extraction subjects and aggregate sizes, establishing why neither public boundary commit is accepted as the true BIC. Fix lifecycle: af938dd148c3fa8d148c51fb664f4e34e6a8ef42 first adds the CVE-named Fetch-Metadata/Origin gate; bfaa7edbb53023f9e3d5fc638a74483b614d3e12 makes missing provenance fail closed; d0f5edf56bbd13e8e16e5a8b770a66e66d03ce61 rejects same-site sibling requests; final direct commit d94dedb56cec78461cd14113c337034734813d58 removes both controller skips and implements verified_request? using token or same-origin provenance. `git show -s --format=fuller 997009a6778687ac8c1f0833f2850ea808742cce` shows main landing merge PR #126 with parents fa99db96a2210016a91540bf9e582980ae5f60fe and 747e8ae2e8f364b1ea8d38089f0ffbc774d008be; `git diff fa99db96a2210016a91540bf9e582980ae5f60fe 997009a6778687ac8c1f0833f2850ea808742cce -- app/controllers` shows the vulnerable skips removed and the fail-closed provenance gate present. Version boundary: `git show 29b423ea:lib/upright/version.rb` is 0.1.0 and `git tag --contains 29b423ea...` returns v0.1.2, v0.2.0, and v0.3.0; no tag contains 997009a..., current lib/upright/version.rb remains 0.3.0, and CHANGELOG.md records CVE-2026-67990 under Unreleased. Thus every repository tag is affected and the fix exists on main but has no tagged patched release.
reasoning: The vulnerability and its repair are reproducible, but AI attribution is not. The first public controller appearance is explicitly a move, and the later route exposure is explicitly a continuation of an extraction; the protocol forbids treating a move, refactor, or aggregate import as the BIC. Because the source project/history from which Upright core was extracted is not present in any repository ref, the smallest original flaw-writing commit and its commit object cannot be recovered. Human identity and absent AI trailers on the two import commits cannot be projected backward onto that missing BIC. This is a genuine public-history boundary, so BLOCKED is required rather than NOT_AI or an AI verdict.
remaining_gap: The pre-extraction version-control history containing the original implementation of the proxy controllers and their routes is not public in the validated repository. Without that history, the smallest true BIC, its immediate parent, direct parent absence, and BIC-only AI marker cannot be established; obtaining the private/source repository history would be required to close the verdict.
